# NYC Taxi — Trips per Month

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Monthly trip counts over time

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_datetime) as month,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    SUM(total_amount) as total_revenue
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2019-01-01'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_datetime)
ORDER BY month
```
